subject: Post-incident operations summary — no exports or exfiltration detected
body:
--- Message 1/3 (oldest) ---
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Anna Lee <anna.lee@novata.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2027 09:15:00 -0700 (PDT)
Subject: Post-incident operations summary — no exports or exfiltration detected

Hi Anna,

Per our call this morning, we completed a targeted forensic sweep across the affected serving cluster and related ingestion pipelines. Short summary of actions performed: 
- Full ingest and request logs were scanned for anomalous bulk download or export patterns (rolling window: 2027-08-08 00:00 — 2027-08-10 08:00 PDT).
- KV/cache snapshot hashes were compared against baseline snapshots taken prior to the incident.
- Object store read logs and data plane egress events were audited for any off-cluster transfers.
- Token-level request traces for sessions matching Novata tenant IDs were sampled and validated.

Findings (high-level):
- No evidence of data export, bulk download, or telemetry indicating exfiltration of customer records.
- KV cache snapshots show no unauthorized read or export operations; hashes match expected baselines.
- Object store audit shows no external PUT/GET requests originating from the compromised node beyond expected service activity.

I have attached an audit-summary CSV with the sampling windows and the hashchain-proof TXT containing SHA256 hashes and a signed timestamp from our forensics service. The appendix PDF has the note on methodology and exact query parameters used.

Next steps we propose:
1) We can provide a signed attestation letter for your compliance team.
2) If helpful, we can schedule a 30 min walkthrough with our forensics lead and your security team to go through artifacts.

Please let us know which you prefer. We prioritize transparency — happy to provide whatever you need for your SOC/compliance records.

Attachments: audit-summary-20270810.csv; hashchain-proof-20270810.txt; forensics-appendix-20270810.pdf

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Incident Response Lead
Redwood Inference
pri...@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

--- Message 2/3 ---
From: Anna Lee <anna.lee@novata.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: security@novata.com
Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2027 10:03:12 -0700 (PDT)
Subject: Re: Post-incident operations summary — no exports or exfiltration detected

Thanks Priyom — appreciated. A couple quick asks from our side: 
- Can you confirm whether the attached hashchain file includes per-object hashes for the KV snapshots or is it a per-snapshot digest only? Our auditors want per-key evidence where available.
- We need a short signed statement (pdf) that we can put into our incident log stating: "Novata customer data was not exported or accessed outside of Redwood production controls during the incident window." Can you provide that?
- Also confirm retention: will the sweep artifacts be retained for 90 days for audit if we request them?

If you can send those three items we can close our internal ticket and update our customers.

--Anna
Anna Lee
Head of Security, Novata Finance
anna.lee@novata.com

--- Message 3/3 (newest) ---
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Anna Lee <anna.lee@novata.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Aug 2027 11:24:00 -0700 (PDT)
Subject: Re: Post-incident operations summary — no exports or exfiltration detected

Hi Anna — thanks for the clear asks. Short answers below and attached artifacts.

1) Hash granularity: the hashchain-proof-20270810.txt contains a per-object (per-key) list for KV snapshots where object-level hashes exist, followed by a snapshot digest. We included metadata lines indicating object path, key id (redacted partial id), timestamp and SHA256 for each entry. Where key-level hashing was not available (legacy indices) we included a snapshot-level digest and noted it in the appendix.

2) Signed statement: attached is a one-page signed attestation (see forensics-appendix-20270810.pdf, page 1 includes the attestation header). The wording reads: "Redwood Inference attests that no Novata Finance customer records were exported or transferred outside Redwood production controls during the incident window 2027-08-08T00:00 — 2027-08-10T08:00 PDT." The PDF includes a timestamp and the forensics lead signature.

3) Artifact retention: we will retain the sweep artifacts (hash lists, sampling records, and full audit CSV) for 90 days from the finalization date (2027-08-11). If you need extended retention, we can discuss a secure transfer to your S3 bucket or a sealed evidence export under an NDA.

Attached files (stubs):
- audit-summary-20270810.csv (contains sampling windows, query ids, row counts)
- hashchain-proof-20270810.txt (per-key hashes and chain values)
- forensics-appendix-20270810.pdf (attestation and methodology)

Related links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Qnovata-audit-evidence (read-only)

If you'd like a walkthrough, suggest Thu 2027-08-12 09:00-09:30 PDT. Marissa, can you coordinate?

Best,
Priyom
Priyom Das
Incident Response Lead
Redwood Inference
